title: Group Room Blocks Cancellation Damages
content:
The cancellation damages of a Group Room Blocks contract are the chargeable room nights times the damages rate times the damages percentage, rounded to the cent once. The chargeable room nights are the contracted room nights, the damages rate is the group rate, and the damages percentage is the scale percentage of the matching step, which is the first step of the block type's cancellation scale, read from the top, whose days-from figure is not greater than the whole calendar days from the date the signed notice is received to the arrival date.

### Elements

| Element | Value |
|---|---|
| Chargeable room nights | the contracted room nights on the block record |
| Damages rate | the group rate |
| Day count | whole calendar days from the date the signed notice is received to the arrival date |
| Matching step | the first step of the block type's cancellation scale, read from the top, whose days-from figure is not greater than the day count |
| Damages percentage | the scale percentage of the matching step |
| Damages | chargeable room nights times damages rate times damages percentage, rounded to the cent once |

### Worked damages (hypothetical block on an assumed three-step scale: 200 days or more 20 percent; 100 days or more 40 percent; 0 days or more 70 percent)

Contracted room nights 120, group rate 189.99 USD.

| Day count | Matching step | Damages |
|---|---|---|
| 250 | 200 days or more, 20 percent | 120 times 189.99 times 20 percent: 4,559.76 USD |
| 150 | 100 days or more, 40 percent | 120 times 189.99 times 40 percent: 9,119.52 USD |
| 100 | 100 days or more, 40 percent | 9,119.52 USD |
| 99 | 0 days or more, 70 percent | 120 times 189.99 times 70 percent: 15,959.16 USD |

Reading from the top, the step at 200 days is passed over for a day count of 150 because 200 is greater than 150; the next step, at 100, is not greater than 150 and is the matching step.
